title: Cleaning Business Insurance Questionnaire
intro: The information disclosed within this questionnaire will be used to obtain insurance quotations on your behalf. Please remember that a fair presentation of the risk must be given. Failure to do so may prevent part or all of a claim being paid and could render the policy invalid. If you are unsure whether or not information applies to giving a fair presentation, it should be disclosed.
